item.title: SITE 2.0 — THE WALL SINGS NOW
item.description: jiansketch.com got rebuilt from scratch. The archive is alive: sweep your cursor across THE WALL and every tile pops and plays a note. There's a fanart film reel, a warning gate, an SFW toggle, and a guestbook coming online. Old neocities page stays up as the time capsule. This is the new home.

item.title: THE STICKER CLUB IS THE MAIN EVENT
item.description: The club is the main event now. Fresh hand-drawn stickers, mailed to you every month — join on Patreon and you also get HI-REZ art, WIPs and timelapses every day.

item.title: SKULLY IS REAL
item.description: The Skully plush shipped with CraftifyX in 2025 and it's REAL. It exists. It can judge you from your shelf. Still in stock — grab one at the link on the home page.
